name: Browse bounties and inspect the acceptance contract
description: Checks that visitors can browse examples and inspect the exact requirements before attempting work.
steps: Open ContribQuest
Choose Explore bounties
Open a bounty card and inspect its acceptance criteria
expected: The board shows scope, category, and review criteria without requiring sign-in.

name: Record and verify the founder's project contribution
description: Verifies the first consumer can record a real network task linked to inspectable work and get one XP award only after all criteria pass.
steps: Sign in and open My contributions
Select Record work
Enter the Contribution Network project, title, work type, outcome description, a GitHub issue or pull request URL, evidence note, one clear criterion, and low risk
Save the contribution and refresh the page
Mark the criterion as met and submit a verification rationale
Refresh the project contribution card and profile progress
expected: The record persists with its work/evidence links and one criteria snapshot. Only after successful low-risk verification does it show Self-verified and 50 XP; retrying verification does not award another 50 XP or increment the community accepted-work gate.

name: Keep higher-risk work provisional until stronger review
description: Checks self-verification is rejected for standard/high-risk or sensitive work and that one account cannot access another account's private ledger records.
steps: Sign in and record a standard- or high-risk contribution with a work URL and evidence note
Inspect its status
Attempt the verify endpoint with every criterion marked true and a valid rationale
Repeat with a record titled around credentials, permissions, security, production, or payment work
While signed into a different account, request the first account's contribution ID
expected: The record remains provisional with no XP; sensitive or non-low-risk work requires stronger review, and cross-user reads return not found rather than disclosing private records.

name: Preserve bounty submission, review, revision and XP controls
description: Protects the existing community bounty workflow as the project contribution ledger is added.
steps: Use separate owner and contributor accounts
Submit written work to an open community bounty
Have the owner request changes with rationale
Resubmit as the original contributor
Pass each criterion and accept the final version
Refresh both accounts and attempt a repeated review
expected: The revision and review history remain visible; only the valid final acceptance awards 50 community XP once, with ownership checks and submission guards intact.

name: Check account and GitHub integration safety
description: Retains mobile and desktop safeguards for account identity, GitHub linking, and owner-gated repository operations.
steps: Sign in and open Account & integrations
Inspect app identity and workspace role
Inspect GitHub setup state and callback URL
Review the device-code flow and verified-email status if configured
As platform owner, verify PAT repository access and read a file
Attempt an unconfigured repository or unauthorized write
expected: The app never claims an unconfigured identity is linked, token values stay server-side, repository access is restricted to configured repositories, and file writes remain owner-gated and explicit.
